analysis_registration_gate.before_new_price_study: Register its hypotheses/directions, endpoints, chronological design, cohort, variants, selection steps, valid inference and multiplicity policy, economic criteria and execution stresses. Validate realistic full-search nulls before using a prospective shortlist policy. Six purchased seasons cannot silently reuse a five-training/five-validation-season requirement.
analysis_registration_gate.holdout: Keep the designated 2026 football season sealed; new historical prices for already explored games are not independent confirmation. Audit actual non-exposure before declaring any holdout untouched.

billing_reconciliation.baseline: Require approved reconciliation input, hashed into run manifest. Capture fresh used/remaining from the first free check or use an explicit documented baseline. Local probe/attempt budgets never reset.
billing_reconciliation.billing_period_utc: Approved YYYY-MM UTC period required; old-period approval cannot initialize or resume a run.
billing_reconciliation.bulk_margin_basis: Existing headers.analyze recommendation: max(5000, 2 * probe measured answer lateness * 30). Wrapper independently applies stricter 100-credit cumulative unexplained-usage and lag guards.
billing_reconciliation.jobs: Do not pause forward-test jobs or inspect sealed signal logs. Bounded shared-key usage is accounted for; exceeding margin halts. Use a quiet window when available; no claimed guarantee of exclusivity.
billing_reconciliation.max_baseline_used: Mandatory hub-approved nonnegative ceiling. Fresh adopted baseline above it halts before any paid reservation. Hub supplies the number at approval time; never infer it from the existing paid usage.
billing_reconciliation.pre_run_usage: An explicit documented pre-run other-usage debit is permitted. Otherwise conservatively reserve all current-period used credits as additional budget debit, even where that double-counts this probe. Do not infer zero unrelated usage from a counter reset.
billing_reconciliation.recovery: Approve an account-only reconciliation to resume when no paid attempt is pending. A pending attempt may only be reconciled offline from an exact hash-pinned cached response under an explicit owner note, retaining conservative debit and all evidence. No automatic resend.
billing_reconciliation.reset: Initial reset may be adopted by approved reconciliation; in-run large used regression or remaining rise halts. Account-only recovery requires an explicit new reconciliation; unknown paid attempts cannot be cleared or resent.
billing_reconciliation.tracking: Within one documented epoch: cumulative highest-used and lowest-remaining counters, compared with cumulative reconciled own bills. Reserve the peak positive external discrepancy once; tolerate bounded stale headers without double-counting catch-up. Use the lower of observed remaining and baseline minus own bills/external debit for reserve protection.

budgets.execution_authorization: Preparation only. The hub must give its go-ahead for this exact committed request list and the owner must approve its scoped authorization before any paid send.

bundle_freeze.canonical_json: UTF-8 JSON, sorted keys, compact separators, no NaN
bundle_freeze.protocol_before_builder: The builder verifies and records the protocol byte digest before reading matching metadata or constructing requests. Any rule or request change requires a new version and root hash.
bundle_freeze.root: SHA-256 of sorted relative filename-to-byte-digest map, excluding only FREEZE.json. Includes protocol, inputs, metadata, registry, request list, candidate maps, sources, execution dependencies, portable tests and rehearsal evidence. Execution status/ledgers live outside bundle.

cache_handoff.raw_layout: ~/Library/Application Support/ValueFinder/football-acquisition-state/<frozen-root>/data/raw/{sport}/oddsapi/hist_odds/{date}/{cache_key}.parquet; fixed across clones and outside all git checkouts
cache_handoff.reader_gate: cache_handoff.py exposes the exact completed recent list and both paid/reused response paths to the existing price-engine run(cfg,calls,cache) interface. Stock CLI replans legacy F1; the hub must approve this manifest-driven integration and the analysis registration before grading. Never run legacy F1 again to populate a second cache.
cache_handoff.reused_responses: 24 frozen reuse files remain in the bundle; an analysis adapter must include those paths together with completed paid responses.
cache_handoff.scope: No cache publication, price-engine run, outcome joins or graded research under this acquisition protocol.

canonical_game_matching.candidate_rule: For a provider observation, require exactly one external metadata game with the same sport, season and team pair whose scheduled kickoff differs by at most 24 hours. Multiple candidates, unknown aliases or no candidate are quarantined with reasons; do not transitively chain time-near records or widen the tolerance.
canonical_game_matching.canonical_close_listing: Latest returned provider snapshot observed strictly before BOTH its stated kickoff and the independent scheduled kickoff. Break ties by newer listing first-observed time, then smaller absolute kickoff discrepancy, then provider ID. A first-observed time is only a tie-breaker and not proof of publication or odds availability.
canonical_game_matching.entry_schedule: Bind exact provider ID and canonical game to immutable observation/response available by decision time. Quarantine simultaneous conflicting versions for the quoted listing; no provider-ID-order resolution.
canonical_game_matching.external_nfl_source_population: The frozen external NFL index is played-game metadata, not a complete historical opportunity schedule. Provider-observed opportunities, including unmatched listings, remain a separate denominator.
canonical_game_matching.key: Sport, season, normalized unordered team pair and one uniquely matched external game ID.
canonical_game_matching.no_valid_pregame_listing: Quarantine; do not select a post-start listing as a substitute.
canonical_game_matching.provider_id_conflict: If observations map one provider ID to more than one canonical game, quarantine that ID in full; do not reassign it after observing prices or outcomes.
canonical_game_matching.provider_ids: Retain all matched IDs and all historical observations, including rejected observations and reasons.
canonical_game_matching.source_cfb_universe: All uniquely matched games listed under the historical featured NCAAF sport, with division flags retained. FBS-only or other registered study subsets must be explicit downstream.

execution_contract.acceptance: No send outside authorized allowlist or without durable budget reservation; no automatic resend of unresolved attempt; conservative accounting and halt when billing cannot be reconciled. No guarantee about provider billing or unrelated key activity.
execution_contract.authorization: Approved owner artifact plus authenticated hub PR #99 comment, bound to CSV hash, exact request-set hash, 82,830-credit cap, frozen root and current full git commit. Owner evidence is recorded after the hub comment. New commits invalidate approval.
execution_contract.billing: Within one documented epoch: cumulative highest-used and lowest-remaining counters, compared with cumulative reconciled own bills. Reserve the peak positive external discrepancy once; tolerate bounded stale headers without double-counting catch-up. Use the lower of observed remaining and baseline minus own bills/external debit for reserve protection.
execution_contract.cache: Frozen probe reuse hashes must match. Missing/changed reused cache halts; no automatic replacement purchase. Paid resumed cache requires completed ledger hash, not cache existence alone.
execution_contract.dependencies: Freeze wrapper, validator, coverage and eligibility plus vendored BulkClient/cache/HTTP/settings/normalize dependency source. Record external runtime distribution versions and enforce the frozen runtime lock.
execution_contract.persistence: Fixed absolute root-keyed runtime outside every git checkout, separate durable registration marker, process lock and durable reservations. Ledger/folder deletion never silently recreates spending capacity. No automatic resend of any attempted request; missing terminal records retain upper-bound debit.
execution_contract.recovery: Structural/cumulative budget checks precede approved recovery; replace the stopped account epoch before enforcing its floor. Preserve all probe, attempt and external debits. Saved-response reconciliation requires exact hash. Accept-as-missing requires hub comment bound to root, request, stopped ledger, reason and current commit, and exact cache/observed failure evidence; it never resends or lowers reservations.
execution_contract.retry: Zero client and adapter retries; redirects prohibited.

metadata_reads.prohibited_columns: Scores, profits, winner/cover/push labels, final weather, closing lines and current-game performance features.

opportunity_accounting.canonical_population: Matched played-game population is reported separately; no silent inner joins.
opportunity_accounting.counts: Report provider IDs, canonical games, intended decisions, timestamp slots, pairs, voids and exclusion reasons separately.
opportunity_accounting.universe: All provider IDs observed in frozen historical sweeps, supplemented by returned purchase snapshots; not proof of all listings ever offered.
opportunity_accounting.unmatched: Keep separate IDs, candidate other-ID matches, supporting evidence and unresolved status. No extra unmatched close purchase under v3 without a new frozen request amendment.

price_row_eligibility.actual_play_evidence: Independent canonical-game-bound first-play evidence may only exclude or certify already scheduled-pregame eligible rows. It never overrides provider/independent schedule checks to admit a decision or execution at or after either scheduled kickoff.
price_row_eligibility.close_primary_guard: Require the returned close snapshot to precede the earlier of selected provider and independent scheduled start, with lead time 5 through 20 minutes relative to the provider anchor. A kickoff discrepancy greater than five minutes is diagnostic-only until independent actual-play timing is resolved. Certification as pre-actual-play requires an independently verified actual-play timestamp.

close_selection.known_actual_play: Snapshot must satisfy the 5–20 minute provider close proxy window and independent scheduled safety check. Known actual first play additionally requires its 5–20 minute window; it never rescues an ineligible scheduled row.
close_selection.rule: Evaluate all frozen candidate rows. If eligible candidates exist, select latest returned snapshot, then freshest quote timestamp, then lexicographically smallest immutable quote_id. Unresolved equally timed contradictory kickoff observations are quarantined. Never rank by line, odds, CLV, result or profit. No eligible candidate means missing primary close, with all diagnostics retained.

price_row_eligibility.clv: Report line movement and price movement separately. Do not convert different totals/spreads to monetary EV without a registered calibrated distribution and push treatment.
price_row_eligibility.decision_preplay_guard: Require the decision and snapshot to precede the independent scheduled start and the latest schedule known at that decision. Missing as-of schedule or material unresolved kickoff conflict means quarantine for primary grading.
price_row_eligibility.execution_universe: Only a preregistered basket of books simultaneously accessible in one jurisdiction may support pooled execution claims. Until that basket is verified, report book-specific results; Pinnacle/LowVig/BetOnline remain references, not assumed domestic execution venues.
price_row_eligibility.fills: Historical quotations are not verified fills. Baseline quote diagnostics cannot establish executable profit. Stress delays at 5, 15, 30 and 60 minutes using actual observed quotes in the required time window; missing follow-up quotes are unavailable or inconclusive, never carried forward or interpolated.
price_row_eligibility.forecast_availability: Use decision-time forecast vintages. Runtime plus the existing assumed publication delay is labeled assumed availability, not proven dissemination. Verified-publication and assumed-publication analyses are kept distinct.
price_row_eligibility.independent_schedule: Without independently proven version availability, final independent schedule is a retrospective safety check only, never an entry feature.
price_row_eligibility.missing_book_or_market: Record missingness; do not replace the chosen book with whichever later looks best.
price_row_eligibility.missing_or_future_quote_timestamp: Ineligible for primary price grading; retained with reason, never imputed from snapshot time.
price_row_eligibility.missing_reference: Pinnacle is required for the primary reference CLV diagnostic at both entry and close. Missing Pinnacle produces an explicit exclusion; own-book movement is a separately labeled descriptive result, not a replacement primary endpoint.
price_row_eligibility.postponements: Preserve original attempted decisions; a separately labeled paper-replay listing void applies when verified eventual kickoff differs from as-of kickoff by more than 24 hours. Multiple-listing policy remains study-specific; no automatic re-entry or erasure. Do not infer every bookmaker settlement from this rule.
price_row_eligibility.quote_basis: Exact provider game ID mapped to one canonical game, bookmaker, market, side, line and offered price; no interpolated prices or silent substitutions.
price_row_eligibility.settlement: Exact line, side, price, pushes, cancellations/voids and overtime treatment must follow the relevant bookmaker rules. No scored-return analysis until settlement mappings are registered and verified.
price_row_eligibility.sides: Totals: Over/Under only. Spreads/h2h: resolved canonical team key that belongs to the exact response event; never join by generic home/away position.

status_contract.actual_play_certified: Passes mandatory scheduled/provider timing and freshness plus independent proof it preceded actual play. Later-known actual play can only exclude, never admit.
status_contract.conflicted_or_ineligible: Rule failed or material timing conflict unresolved.
status_contract.scheduled_pregame_eligible: Passes identity, schedule and freshness guards; may remain an uncertified scheduled proxy.

purchase_order_and_gates.before_older_slice: For this exact combined residual only, replace the original unconditional priority-1 halt with the saved accepted six-PASS-group coverage decision. Execute NFL2023-24 props then only NFL2020-22 and CFB2020 totals in the same finite tranche. No new coverage look or automatic next-stage release; held groups remain excluded.
purchase_order_and_gates.live_rule_gate: MOS evening slots do not validate the live Open-Meteo rule. Standard-time 02:30 UTC slots and the 1-to-3-day/four-alert-time panel are deferred until a separate prospectively registered forecast-availability, alert-time, eligibility, execution-delay and capped-request protocol exists. Existing expansion gates remain in force or require an explicit prospective amendment.
purchase_order_and_gates.mandatory_halt: Billing mismatch, unreadable billing/balance, credential exposure, reserve/budget breach, missing returned timestamps, response hash mismatch, unresolved canonical ambiguity entering a primary sample, or incomplete coverage accounting. Require documented resolution before continuing.

passing_groups_stage_acceptance.before_older_slice: For this exact combined residual only, replace the original unconditional priority-1 halt with the saved accepted six-PASS-group coverage decision. Execute NFL2023-24 props then only NFL2020-22 and CFB2020 totals in the same finite tranche. No new coverage look or automatic next-stage release; held groups remain excluded.
passing_groups_stage_acceptance.ledger_priority_meaning: technical allowlist class for this combined tranche; not original season priority

registration_timing: Hub-requested refreeze on 2026-10-01 before any bulk purchase: request rows and strategy registrations unchanged; execution safeguards and exclusion-only schedule eligibility repaired after review, without outcomes.

request_schedule.alternate_close: For all 54 v2 games with schedule disagreement over five minutes, retain provider-anchor candidate and add floor(final independent schedule minus five minutes) candidate. Union exact sport/time/market/book cache identities and preserve all candidate mappings; final schedule used for acquisition only.
request_schedule.close_request: Floor the selected provider kickoff minus five minutes to the five-minute UTC request grid.
request_schedule.close_timing: Record requested time, returned snapshot time, market/book update time, provider kickoff, independent scheduled kickoff and actual-play timestamp when verified. Do not claim a universally exact T-5 or T-10 observation.
request_schedule.daily: 16:00 UTC once per sport/time during each canonical game's seven-day pregame window, plus its close proxy; union requests across games.
request_schedule.first_observed: Label event discovery first_observed_by_two_day_sweep, not first_listed or first_price. Fewer than two days before kickoff is a coverage stratum, not automatic evidence that earlier odds did not exist.
request_schedule.legacy_close_reconciliation: Match each legacy close timestamp to projected replay timing metadata and canonical games; record equal/grid-equivalent, provider-kickoff revision, absent provider coverage, ambiguous metadata or no valid pregame listing. Never purchase an unmatched legacy close merely because it was in the old list. Quarantined reasons remain explicit.
request_schedule.mos_entry: 19:30 America/Los_Angeles on the local date preceding the game's original replay kickoff date in America/New_York; preserve the original 665 distinct slots, including daylight-saving changes.

scope: Outcome-blind acquisition, matching and price eligibility; no new strategy, outcome join or hypothesis test is authorized by this protocol.

team_identity.ambiguous_alias: Quarantine; no outcome-based or price-based tie-breaking.
team_identity.cfb: Explicit rename exceptions followed by longest exact normalized school-name token prefix; normalization folds accents and punctuation and treats & as and. No fuzzy name matching. Materialize every resolved provider alias and source school ID in the frozen bundle.
team_identity.nfl: Exact checked team-name/code aliases from the existing NFL team table, with Washington Football Team mapped to WAS.
